title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: What data TopProductPick collects, how it's used and the choices you have.
lede: We collect as little as possible.

p: This site does not require accounts and does not use advertising cookies. Our host may keep standard server logs, such as IP address and browser type, for security and performance.
When you click a link to Amazon, Amazon's own privacy policy applies to what happens on their site, including cookies used to attribute purchases.
If you switch between light and dark mode, your choice is saved in your browser only.
